items.detail: Eye injury from Nov 18 (Udoka: swelling in right eye and a scratch on the left cornea, 'not sure what that means time-wise'); played only 14 min that game and Houston said it likely won't know until Friday whether he plays, with backup C Steven Adams also questionable (quad) and Clint Capela out (ankle).

note: Morning run: only new detail is Sengun's eye injury (real doubt, open RA Under). No news found beyond the official report for Randle, Peterson, Battle, Coby White or Zion.
